subject: Deployment readiness: VPC + air-gapped options & vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <j.doe@mednexa.com>, IT Security <security@mednexa.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment readiness: VPC + air-gapped options & vendor questionnaire

Thanks again for making time today — good conversation and helpful clarity on the use case. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have an actionable path to qualify Private/VPC or air-gapped options for your environment.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: run inference for PHI-sensitive workloads in a restricted environment with strict audit trails.
- Preferred topology: VPC-hosted private deployment with the option to escalate to an air-gapped appliance for the most sensitive pipelines.
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA (core), GDPR for EU patients, and an internal SOC 2 certification schedule (target Q2 next year).

Immediate asks / next steps
1) We shared a short vendor security questionnaire during the call — I attached a PDF version for you to complete (vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf). Please mark any items that require redaction for internal review.
2) Could you provide a simple network sketch showing the proposed egress constraints, NAT/egress proxies, and any on-prem resources that need to reach Redwood (if any)? A PNG or PDF is fine — I attached a blank template (network-sketch.png).
3) We also shared a deployment-readiness matrix (attached) that maps capability to evidence (e.g., KMS/HSM, encryption at rest, audit logs retention, SOC 2 scope). Please fill the left column with your target SLOs and we’ll map recommended configurations and quantization/throughput tradeoffs.
4) If you have any SOC 2 artifacts already (SOC 2 Type I/II), an initial PDF or SOC audit timeline would help us triage which controls we need to supplement on the Private deployment.

Proposed timeline
- Complete questionnaire + matrix: within 5 business days so we can schedule a technical workshop.
- Technical workshop: 60–90 min to review network diagram, firewall rules, and necessary evidence access.

Attachments referenced: vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf, deployment-readiness-matrix.xlsx, network-sketch.png

Thanks — happy to help clarify anything.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Naomi —

Thanks for the concise recap and the materials. A couple clarifying notes from our side before we start completing the questionnaire: 

1) For air-gapped option: we need explicit guidance on evidence required for physical access controls and logistics for RMA/patching. Can you provide an example checklist or a statement of responsibilities for on-site maintenance?
2) For KMS: confirm support for external HSM (BYOK) workflows and whether Redwood Private can be configured to point to our Azure Key Vault HSM-backed keys or an HSM on-prem.
3) Audit logs: we need retention options up to 7 years for certain workloads; what’s supported out-of-the-box and what requires add-ons?

We’ll take the questionnaire and return it with redactions as appropriate. Also attaching a high-level internal network summary (mednexa-initial-netflow.pdf) for your workshop reference — contains flow-level descriptions but no IP ranges.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Security Engineer — MedNexa Health
security@mednexa.com

Subject: Re: Deployment readiness: VPC + air-gapped options & vendor questionnaire

Alex / John —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the mednexa-initial-netflow.pdf — that’ll be helpful for the workshop. A few quick replies inline to your asks and some attached reference docs: 

- Air-gapped checklist: attached a short responsibilities statement in the shared drive link and included a list in the matrix. In general the air-gapped appliance model covers software signing, signed-image updates via USB-only media, and an on-site operator runbook. Redwood can support scheduled offline updates; we’ll need an on-site engineer for image application and a signer/key exchange step.
- HSM/BYOK: Redwood Private supports customer-supplied key material. We can integrate with Azure Key Vault (if you allow egress to the vault endpoints) or with a local HSM via a PKCS#11-compatible path. We’ll document the recommended configuration in the tech workshop and in the runbook.
- Audit logs: out-of-the-box retention is 90 days; we offer add-on archival to S3-compatible storage with configurable retention up to 7 years. That archival feature will require the compliance add-on (documented in the matrix).

I attached: vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf (fillable), deployment-readiness-matrix.xlsx (template), network-sketch.png (blank). I also added a short example maintenance responsibilities blurb to the shared drive link in related_links.

Would next Wednesday (Nov 17) 10:00–11:30 PT work for a 90-minute workshop with your engineers? Karthik and Monica will join to cover architecture and SOC2 mapping respectively.

Best,
Naomi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
